# Pet Finder Agent Instructions

Read the root `AGENTS.md` before changing code. It is the shared project source of truth.

Before editing, read the relevant document:

- architecture or data flow: `docs/architecture.md`;
- local workflow or validation: `docs/development.md`;
- Supabase, migrations, RLS, or generated types: `docs/database.md`;
- translations or locales: `docs/i18n.md`;
- pets: `docs/features/pets.md`;
- shelters: `docs/features/shelters.md`.

Keep changes scoped to the owning feature, validate external input on the server, preserve authorization and RLS, and run the narrowest relevant check after editing.
